gemini.rationale: The Arysta acquisition was a whole-business share purchase of Arysta LifeScience Limited and its subsidiaries. The product portfolio (T4), operational processes (T5), and management/people (T6) transferred together and were integrated into a single AgroSolutions segment alongside prior acquisitions, with no documented structural mismatch or transition services agreement at closing.

grok.rationale: gap_45=0 because the Arysta closing was a whole-company share purchase of a going corporate group whose crop-protection/biosolutions product portfolio crossed together with the businesses that produce it, and Agriphar/CAS/Arysta were structurally folded into one AgroSolutions segment expected to operate under one brand (10-K FY2014; 8-K 0001171843-15-000857 Item 2.01). gap_56=0 because at the same closing Wayne Hewett (Arysta CEO) was appointed Platform President to lead AgroSolutions and the CAS/Agriphar/Arysta integration, and CAS’s management team including its president likewise joined the segment, so process consolidation was paired with incoming organization (8-K Item 5.02; 10-K FY2014). No TSA/shared-services exhibit was filed, but no structural tier mismatch required mitigation.
